dossier_meta.statement_text: What is the minimum number of edges in an $r$-vertex intersecting hypergraph if any subset of $m$ vertices needs to contain at least $t$ edges?
dossier_meta.context_text: One of several open questions posed by the authors in Section 4, concerned with the behaviour of $f(n,r,s)$ and/or $g(n,r,s)$.
